reviewer: independent reviewer; did not build or edit R1

criteria.name: Identity and footprint
findings: Purdue GIS FID 857 shell AABB matches the recorded transformed envelope.
AABB agreement does not establish wall-by-wall fit or resolve FID 108 and the five historical wings.

criteria.name: Placement and orientation
findings: Asset root remains identity and local origin is unchanged.
Purdue supports the entrance facing the Engineering Fountain, but R1 does not include a master-marker check and exact along-wall entry position is estimated.

criteria.name: Form, height, and roof
findings: The 18.5 m shell height is inherited and unverified.
The complex has five phases; mixed roof forms are visible in Purdue's uncalibrated phase illustration, but R1 retains a broad flat roof and one overall massing height.

criteria.name: Facade, materials, and entrance
findings: R1 adds 208 applied openings, glazing, frames, sills, bands, qualitative brick, and an arched stone entrance supported as feature categories by Purdue photos.
Exact window count, schedule, facade-to-wing mapping, and entrance along-wall position remain estimated rather than measured or registered.

criteria.name: Interior and circulation
findings: Existing floor plates and partitions remain approximate and unchanged.
Historical plans exclude Gatewood; current circulation and post-renovation room layout are not verified.

criteria.name: Technical integrity
findings: Blender 5.2.3 reopen validation passes with expected collection, applied Boolean, identity root, existing renders, and no external image dependencies.

decision: Below the 8.0/10 acceptance target. Exterior improvements are substantial, but roof/height, facade registration, FID 108 relationship, current interior and master placement remain unresolved.
